concept.title: Undertone Cheat Sheet - Mirror Corner
concept.hook: Diwali mein aath din aur plan zero? Ruko.
concept.voiceoverScript: Diwali ke teen looks, aur har undertone ke liye ek. Pehla, subah ke liye: yeh light blue Anarkali. Cool undertones walon, yeh aapka hai. Doosra, lunch ya family visit ke liye: yeh brown chanderi suit. Yeh embroidery dekho. Olive ya warm undertones pur yeh brown bahut sundar lagta hai. Aur raat ki party? Green sharara set, gota patti aur embroidered dupatta ke saath. Golden undertones hain toh yeh green lovely lagega.

scenes.visualPrompt: A getting-ready corner in an Indian home with a tall wooden-framed standing mirror, a cane chair, and a brass urli of floating marigold petals on a side table, warm string lights mixed with soft white daylight from a side window, calm, friendly mood. Vertical full-body framing from a fixed camera at chest height. She wears a light blue georgette suit set: a flared Anarkali-style strappy kurta with round neck, embellished yoke and sheer flared panels, with matching light blue pants with gota detailing, exact design as shown in the product reference. The outfit is copied from the product reference with nothing added or changed: the yoke embellishment matches the reference exactly in placement, size, density and colour, and everything outside what the reference shows stays plain light blue georgette, with no extra embroidery, motifs, prints or patterns added on the chest, bodice or kurta. She opens already facing the lens, holding up three fingers to camera with a bright, playful smile and a slight lean forward, then laughs and twirls so the sheer flares lift. She lightly lifts the edge of one sheer flared panel at her side, keeping her hands away from her chest so the yoke stays clearly visible. She ends by snapping her fingers toward the lens while starting a quick spin.
scenes.dialogue: Diwali ke teen looks, aur har undertone ke liye ek. Pehla, subah ke liye: yeh light blue Anarkali. Cool undertones walon, yeh aapka hai.

concept.caption:
Your Diwali undertone cheat sheet 🪔 Cool undertones, try the light blue georgette Anarkali for the morning. Olive or warm, try the brown chanderi for lunch and family visits. Golden, try the green gotta patti sharara for the night party. Just my styling take, so wear whatever makes you happy 💛

Light blue georgette set: Bunai
Brown chanderi suit set: Aachho
Green sharara set: evadesignerstudio
concept.musicMood: Playful, light Bollywood-lounge beat with a finger-snap sound on each transition, warming into a soft festive swell at the end
